mapper.select: SELECT so.id, so.shipping_no, so.provider_id, so.shipping_date, so.estimated_arrival_date, so.estimated_days, so.shipping_method, so.shipping_route, so.target_region_id, so.package_count, so.total_weight, so.unit_price, so.shipping_fee, so.misc_fee, so.total_amount, so.total_amount_cny, so.payment_status, so.payment_voucher_file_id, so.shipping_status, so.stock_posting_id, so.remark, so.create_time FROM wms_shipping_order so WHERE so.id = #{id} AND so.deleted = 0

SELECT po.id AS purchase_order_id, po.order_no AS purchase_order_no, poi.id AS purchase_order_item_id, poi.sku_code, poi.quantity AS purchase_quantity, IFNULL(poi.shipped_quantity, 0) AS shipped_quantity, (poi.quantity - IFNULL(poi.shipped_quantity, 0) - IFNULL(pending_reserved.reserved_quantity, 0)) AS available_quantity, po.supplier_id FROM wms_purchase_order_item poi INNER JOIN wms_purchase_order po ON poi.purchase_order_id = po.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT soi.purchase_order_item_id, SUM(soi.quantity) AS reserved_quantity FROM wms_shipping_order_item soi INNER JOIN wms_shipping_order so ON so.id = soi.shipping_order_id WHERE so.deleted = 0 AND so.shipping_status = 'PENDING'
AND so.id <> #{qo.shippingOrderId}
GROUP BY soi.purchase_order_item_id ) pending_reserved ON pending_reserved.purchase_order_item_id = poi.id
po.deleted = 0 AND po.order_status IN ('IN_PRODUCTION', 'PARTIAL_SHIPPED') AND (poi.quantity - IFNULL(poi.shipped_quantity, 0) - IFNULL(pending_reserved.reserved_quantity, 0)) > 0
AND po.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{qo.purchaseOrderNo}, '%')
AND poi.sku_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{qo.skuCode}, '%')
AND po.supplier_id = #{qo.supplierId}
ORDER BY po.expected_delivery_date ASC, po.order_no ASC, poi.id ASC

SELECT so.id, so.shipping_no, so.provider_id, lp.provider_name, so.shipping_date, so.target_region_id, COALESCE(SUM(soi.quantity), 0) AS total_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(soi.received_quantity), 0) AS received_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(soi.quantity - soi.received_quantity - soi.inbound_reserved_quantity), 0) AS pending_quantity FROM wms_shipping_order so LEFT JOIN wms_logistics_provider lp ON so.provider_id = lp.id LEFT JOIN wms_shipping_order_item soi ON so.id = soi.shipping_order_id
so.deleted = 0 AND so.shipping_status IN ('SHIPPED', 'PARTIAL_ARRIVED', 'ALL_ARRIVED')
AND so.shipping_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{qo.shippingNo}, '%')
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wms_shipping_order_item soi2 INNER JOIN wms_purchase_order po ON soi2.purchase_order_id = po.id WHERE soi2.shipping_order_id = so.id AND po.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{qo.purchaseOrderNo}, '%') )
AND so.provider_id = #{qo.providerId}
GROUP BY so.id, so.shipping_no, so.provider_id, lp.provider_name, so.shipping_date, so.target_region_id HAVING pending_quantity > 0 ORDER BY so.shipping_date DESC

SELECT so.id, so.shipping_no, so.provider_id, so.shipping_date, so.estimated_arrival_date, so.shipping_method, so.shipping_route, so.shipping_status, so.package_count, so.total_amount, so.payment_status, SUM(soi.quantity) AS shipped_quantity, SUM(soi.received_quantity) AS received_quantity FROM wms_shipping_order so INNER JOIN wms_shipping_order_item soi ON so.id = soi.shipping_order_id WHERE so.deleted = 0 AND soi.purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId} GROUP BY so.id, so.shipping_no, so.provider_id, so.shipping_date, so.estimated_arrival_date, so.shipping_method, so.shipping_route, so.shipping_status, so.package_count, so.total_amount, so.payment_status ORDER BY so.shipping_date DESC, so.create_time DESC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity), 0) AS total_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(received_quantity), 0) AS received_quantity FROM wms_shipping_order_item WHERE shipping_order_id = #{shippingOrderId}
